content:
The **Flatwoods Meeting Hall** is an unmarked location in the Appalachian town of Flatwoods.

The location was utilized by the survivors living in Flatwoods as a place of respite, remembering those they had lost and sharing similar experiences with one another in an attempt to process grief.

A single story building on Church Street, the meeting hall is directly next to the Green Country Bridge. A sign reading "MEETING HALL" can be found on a Responders sign in front, next to a Pick-R-Up truck under an awning. Inside the building, a small altar has been set up with various mementos and notes underneath a halkboard reading "remember them."

The Flatwoods Meeting Hall appears in *Fallout 76*.
